title: noccaea bulbosa
intro: Noccaea bulbosa, commonly known as winter savory, is a perennial plant species that belongs to the Brassicaceae family. Winter savory has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, relieving digestive issues, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Noccaea bulbosa include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic effects, which contribute to its use in treating various ailments. The bioactive constituents of this plant include volatile oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
